claims.claim: Datasection's roughly 15,000-Blackwell lease to Tencent and an 80 billion yen order were canceled after U.S. rules issued November 16, and full-year revenue guidance fell from 162 billion yen to 17 billion yen, about 89 percent.
claims.episode_span: a ¥80 billion AI order was canceled after U.S. export-control rules issued November 16
claims.source_title: Datasection Loses an 80 Billion Yen AI Order from Tencent Amid U.S. Export Controls
claims.supporting_quote: Datasection previously leased approximately 15,000 Blackwell GPUs primarily to Tencent, but following new export control rules issued by the U.S. on November 16, a ¥80 billion AI order was canceled.

claims.claim: The November 16 rules require an export license for data centers globally that provide substantial computing power to Chinese headquarters enterprises using controlled advanced chips, and add Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Brazil to enhanced licensing.
claims.episode_span: require an export license for any data center globally that provides substantial computing power to Chinese headquarters enterprises
claims.source_title: Datasection Loses an 80 Billion Yen AI Order from Tencent Amid U.S. Export Controls
claims.supporting_quote: The new rules require that any data center globally providing substantial computing power to Chinese headquarters enterprises using controlled advanced chips must obtain an export license.
